> If that file exists, its rules **override** this file. If not, follow the rules below.

---

## Global Rules

### Style

**Minimalism & Swiss Style** — geometric, grid-based, high contrast, essential.
Density is high: this is an operator console, not a marketing site.

**Key effects:** 150 ms colour/border transitions only. Sharp, neutral shadows.
No decorative blur, no glow, no gradient text, no ambient colour blobs.

### Color Tokens

Declared in `src/app/globals.css` as space-separated RGB channels and exposed in
`tailwind.config.ts` as Tailwind colors, so components never use raw hex.

| Role | Value | Tailwind | Variable |
|------|-------|----------|----------|
| Background | `#09090B` | `bg-surface` | `--surface` |
| Card / panel | `#121215` | `bg-panel` | `--panel` |
| Raised surface | `#18181C` | `bg-panel-elevated` | `--panel-elevated` |
| Border | `#222227` | `border-border` | `--border` |
| Border strong | `#34343C` | `border-border-bright` | `--border-bright` |
| Accent / interactive | `#3B82F6` | `text-accent`, `bg-accent` | `--accent` |
| Accent (pressed) | `#2563EB` | `bg-accent-dim` | `--accent-dim` |
| On accent | `#FFFFFF` | `text-on-accent` | `--on-accent` |
| Muted text | `#A1A1AA` | `text-muted` | `--muted` |

**Contrast (WCAG 2.1 AA, normal text):**

| Pair | Ratio |
|------|-------|
| muted `#A1A1AA` on surface `#09090B` | 8.7:1 (AAA) |
| muted `#A1A1AA` on panel `#121215` | 8.0:1 (AAA) |
| on-accent `#FFFFFF` on accent `#3B82F6` | 4.6:1 (AA) |
| accent `#3B82F6` on surface `#09090B` | 5.2:1 (AA) |

> **Deliberate design rationale — Institutional Quant Foundation.** Replaces
> generic murky blue/slate (`#020617` / `#0E1223`) with neutral obsidian/carbon dark
> mode (`#09090B` / `#121215`). Green and red are reserved exclusively for value
> direction and status semantics. High-contrast white text on accent provides
> instant visual clarity for primary CTAs.

### Typography

| Role | Family |
|------|--------|
| UI / body | Inter (`next/font`, `--font-sans`) |
| Code, IDs, API addresses | system monospace stack (`font-mono`) |
| Numeric columns | `tabular-nums` (applied to `table.data td`) |

> **Deliberate deviation — font pairing.** The generator suggests Fira Sans /
> Fira Code. Inter is already a neutral UI sans and avoids an extra webfont
> request; the data legibility the Fira pairing targets is achieved with
> `tabular-nums` plus the system mono stack for identifiers.

Scale: 11 / 12 / 13 / 14 / 16 / 18 / 24 / 30 / 36 px. Body 14–16 px, line-height 1.5–1.6.

### Spacing (density 8/10)

4 / 8 / 12 / 16 / 24 / 32 px rhythm. Card padding 20 px (`p-5`), section gap 32–40 px
(`space-y-8 sm:space-y-10`), grid gap 16 px (`gap-4`).

### Elevation

| Token | Value | Usage |
|-------|-------|-------|
| `shadow-card` | `0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .28)` | Rare — cards rely on borders |
| `shadow-overlay` | `0 12px 32px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / .55)` | Popovers, tooltips, skip link |

One elevation step only. No glow shadows, no coloured shadows.

---

## Component Specs

### Buttons

| Variant | Surface | Text | Hover |
|---------|---------|------|-------|
| Primary | `bg-accent` | `text-on-accent` | `bg-accent/90` |
| Secondary | `bg-panel` + `border-border` | `text-slate-100` | `border-border-bright` |
| Ghost | transparent | `text-slate-300` | `bg-panel-elevated` |

Radius `0.5rem` (`rounded-lg`), height 36 px, horizontal padding 14 px.
Transitions are `transition-colors duration-150` — no lift, no scale, no glow.
Disabled: `opacity-50` + `pointer-events-none`.

### Cards

`rounded-lg border border-border bg-panel p-5 sm:p-6`. No gradient, no inner
hairline, no hover lift. Interactive cards (`stat-card`, `workflow-card`) change
border and background colour only.

### Tables

`table.data` — 1 px `border-border` cells, `bg-panel-elevated` header at 11 px
uppercase, `tabular-nums` on body cells, row hover `bg-panel-elevated/60`.
Sortable columns should expose `aria-sort`.

### Charts

Data first: gridlines low contrast, no gradient fills under lines, legend
visible, direct labels where the dataset is small. Series colours must not rely
on red/green alone — pair with shape, dash pattern, or direct labels.

### Navigation

Opaque `bg-surface` sticky header (`--header-height: 3.75rem`), 1 px bottom
border. Active item: `bg-accent/10` + `ring-accent/30`. Mobile panel is opaque,
no backdrop blur. `html { scroll-padding-top }` keeps focus clear of the header.

---

## Motion

- Page entrance: 180 ms `cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)`, opacity + 4 px translate.
- Hover/press: colour and border only, 150 ms.
- No infinite animations. No scroll-triggered reveals in the console.
- `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` collapses all durations to 0.01 ms globally.

---

## Anti-Patterns (do not use)

### Forbidden in this project

- ❌ Multi-stop decorative gradients (backgrounds, buttons, cards, text)
- ❌ `backdrop-blur` as decoration (chrome, cards, footers)
- ❌ Glow shadows (`shadow-glow`, coloured box-shadows)
- ❌ Hover lift / scale on cards and buttons (`hover:-translate-y-*`)
- ❌ Gradient text (`bg-clip-text text-transparent`)
- ❌ Ambient colour blobs (`blur-3xl` circles behind content)
- ❌ Rainbow accents per card (cyan/violet/emerald per index)
- ❌ Hover-only affordances — controls must be visible without hover
- ❌ Emoji as icons
- ❌ Raw hex values in components — use the semantic tokens
- ❌ Removing focus outlines without a replacement
- ❌ Decorative background graph grids (`.bg-grid` linear-gradients)
- ❌ Redundant horizontal workflow step bars (`WorkflowStrip` with circle numbers and connector lines)
- ❌ Sliding arrow animations on card hover (`group-hover:translate-x-*`)

---

## Pre-Delivery Checklist

- [ ] Tokens only — no raw hex in components
- [ ] Text contrast ≥ 4.5:1 on `surface` and `panel`
- [ ] Visible `:focus-visible` ring on every interactive element
- [ ] `prefers-reduced-motion` respected
- [ ] No hover-only controls or hover-dependent state
- [ ] SVG icons only; decorative icons `aria-hidden`
- [ ] Numeric columns use `tabular-nums`
- [ ] Colour never the sole carrier of meaning (status has text labels)
- [ ] Keyboard focus not obscured by the sticky header
- [ ] Responsive at 375 / 768 / 1024 / 1440 px; no horizontal scroll
